name: wheel-picker
title: Wheel Picker
description: An iOS-style drum picker: real 3D cylinders you drag, flick, scroll or step with the keyboard.

props.name: columns
props.description: The wheels, left to right: { id, label, options, loop?, className? }. Defaults to a 12-hour time picker.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection, keyed by column id.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called once a wheel comes to rest on a new option.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the whole picker.
